newsitem.title: USA: Group cites possible U.S. campaign violations.
newsitem.headline: Group cites possible U.S. campaign violations.

text.p: Common Cause, a watchdog group, said on Tuesday it will ask the Justice Department to act against both the Clinton and Dole presidential campaigns for "potential massive violations" of campaign law.
A spokesman would not spell out what the group planned to announce at a news conference scheduled for Wednesday.

The organisation, which has been lobbying for campaign finance reform by Congress, said only that it would "announce the action it is asking the Justice Department to take regarding potential massive violations of the federal campaign laws by the Clinton and Dole presidential campaigns."
